## Overview

This script maps the BCRS-28 signature onto 10x Visium spatial
transcriptomic data from primary breast carcinoma tissue, including:

- Data download from GEO (GSE203612, NYU_BRCA0 Visium)
- BCRS-28 directional module score computation
- Spatial visualization of signature enrichment
- Spot-level classification (BCRS-28 High vs Low)
- Figure 6 (spatial panels) generation

**Dataset:** Barkley D, et al. Nat Genet. 2022;54(8):1192–1201.  
doi:10.1038/s41588-022-01141-9

**Input:** GSE203612 Visium files  
**Output:** Figure 6 spatial panels

> **Note on cell type deconvolution:** The publicly deposited Visium  
> object contains only three metadata fields (orig.ident, nCount_Spatial,  
> nFeature_Spatial). No spot-level cell type annotations were deposited  
> in the public GEO release. Spot-level deconvolution using matched  
> inDrop scRNA-seq data (NYU_BRCA1–3) as a reference is identified as  
> a future analysis direction.

---

## Step 1 — Libraries

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

dir.create("figures/spatial", showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)
set.seed(42)

# ── BCRS-28 Gene Lists (directional) ────────────────────────────────────────
BCRS28_UP <- c(
  "GADD45G", "CRIP1",   "SNCG",    "PIP",
  "KRT14",   "KRT15",   "MUCL1",   "SERHL2",
  "ANGPTL4", "BAMBI",   "CD14",    "CXCL14",
  "KLK7",    "KLK5",    "RARRES1", "SLC40A1", "FABP3"
)

BCRS28_DOWN <- c(
  "TGM2",    "HMOX1",   "SCGB3A1", "SERPINA5", "FASN",
  "WNT4",    "LMO7",    "CCL20",   "EEF1A2",   "CCDC74A", "GBP1"
)

cat("BCRS-28 up genes:",   length(BCRS28_UP),   "\n")
cat("BCRS-28 down genes:", length(BCRS28_DOWN), "\n")
```

---

## Step 2 — Download Visium Data from GEO

```{r download, eval=FALSE}
# ── Download GSE203612 NYU_BRCA0 Visium sample ─────────────────────────────
# GEO accession: GSE203612
# Sample: GSM6177599 — NYU_BRCA0_Vis 10x Genomics Visium
# Reference: Barkley et al., Nat Genet 2022

spatial_dir <- "data/raw/spatial/GSE203612"
spatial_sub <- file.path(spatial_dir, "spatial")
dir.create(spatial_sub, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)

base_url <- "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/samples/GSM6177nnn/GSM6177599/suppl/"

# Expression matrix
download.file(
  paste0(base_url, "GSM6177599_NYU_BRCA0_Vis_processed_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5.gz"),
  destfile = file.path(spatial_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5.gz"),
  mode = "wb"
)
R.utils::gunzip(file.path(spatial_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5.gz"),
                remove=FALSE)

# Spatial files
spatial_files <- list(
  list(src="GSM6177599_NYU_BRCA0_Vis_processed_spatial_tissue_positions_list.csv.gz",
       dest="tissue_positions_list.csv"),
  list(src="GSM6177599_NYU_BRCA0_Vis_processed_spatial_scalefactors_json.json.gz",
       dest="scalefactors_json.json"),
  list(src="GSM6177599_NYU_BRCA0_Vis_processed_spatial_tissue_hires_image.png.gz",
       dest="tissue_hires_image.png"),
  list(src="GSM6177599_NYU_BRCA0_Vis_processed_spatial_tissue_lowres_image.png.gz",
       dest="tissue_lowres_image.png")
)

for (f in spatial_files) {
  src  <- file.path(spatial_dir, f$src)
  dest <- file.path(spatial_sub, f$dest)
  download.file(paste0(base_url, f$src), destfile=src, mode="wb")
  R.utils::gunzip(src, destfile=dest, remove=FALSE)
  cat("✓ Processed:", f$dest, "\n")
}
cat("Download complete.\n")
```

---

## Step 3 — Load Visium Object

```{r load-visium}
spatial_dir <- "data/raw/spatial/GSE203612"

cat("Loading Visium data...\n")
sp_seu <- Load10X_Spatial(
  data.dir   = spatial_dir,
  filename   = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  assay      = "Spatial",
  slice      = "NYU_BRCA0"
)

cat("Spots:", ncol(sp_seu), "\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(sp_seu), "\n")

# Check available metadata
cat("\nMetadata columns:\n")
print(names(sp_seu@meta.data))

# Note: Only orig.ident, nCount_Spatial, nFeature_Spatial available
# No spot-level cell type annotations in public deposit
```

---

## Step 4 — Normalize & Check BCRS-28 Gene Availability

```{r normalize}
sp_seu <- NormalizeData(sp_seu, verbose=FALSE)

# Check BCRS-28 gene availability
up_found   <- intersect(BCRS28_UP,   rownames(sp_seu))
down_found <- intersect(BCRS28_DOWN, rownames(sp_seu))

cat("Up genes found:",   length(up_found),   "/", length(BCRS28_UP),   "\n")
cat("Down genes found:", length(down_found), "/", length(BCRS28_DOWN), "\n")
cat("Missing up:  ",   setdiff(BCRS28_UP,   rownames(sp_seu)), "\n")
cat("Missing down:", setdiff(BCRS28_DOWN, rownames(sp_seu)), "\n")
```

---

## Step 5 — Compute Directional BCRS-28 Module Score

```{r module-score}
# ── Compute separate up and down scores ────────────────────────────────────
sp_seu <- AddModuleScore(sp_seu,
                          features = list(up_found),
                          name     = "BCRS28_Up",
                          seed     = 42)

sp_seu <- AddModuleScore(sp_seu,
                          features = list(down_found),
                          name     = "BCRS28_Down",
                          seed     = 42)

# ── Combined directional score: up - down ──────────────────────────────────
# High score = up genes high + down genes low = BRCA1-loss pattern
sp_seu$BCRS28_Score <- sp_seu$BCRS28_Up1 - sp_seu$BCRS28_Down1

cat("BCRS-28 score summary:\n")
print(summary(sp_seu$BCRS28_Score))

# ── Classify spots: High vs Low (split by mean) ───────────────────────────
mean_score <- mean(sp_seu$BCRS28_Score, na.rm=TRUE)
sp_seu$BCRS28_Group <- ifelse(sp_seu$BCRS28_Score >= mean_score,
                               "BCRS-28 High", "BCRS-28 Low")

pct_high <- round(mean(sp_seu$BCRS28_Group == "BCRS-28 High")*100, 1)
cat("\nBCRS-28 High spots:", pct_high, "%\n")
cat("BCRS-28 Low spots: ", 100-pct_high, "%\n")
print(table(sp_seu$BCRS28_Group))
```

---

## Step 6 — Figure 6: Spatial Visualization {.tabset}

### Panel A — Continuous BCRS-28 Score

```{r fig6a, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
fig6A <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  sp_seu,
  features    = "BCRS28_Score",
  pt.size.factor = 1.3,
  alpha       = c(0.3, 1)
) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#2ABAB4",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "#E41A1C",
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "BCRS-28\nScore"
  ) +
  labs(title = "A  BCRS-28 Signature Score\n(NYU Breast Carcinoma — 10x Visium)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=12))

fig6A
```

### Panel B — High vs Low Classification

```{r fig6b, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
fig6B <- SpatialDimPlot(
  sp_seu,
  group.by       = "BCRS28_Group",
  pt.size.factor = 1.3,
  alpha          = c(0.3, 1)
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("BCRS-28 High" = "#E41A1C",
               "BCRS-28 Low"  = "#2ABAB4"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(title = paste0("B  BCRS-28 High vs Low\n(",
                      pct_high, "% spots BCRS-28 High)")) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold",hjust=0.5,size=12))

fig6B
```

### Panel C — Score Distribution

```{r fig6c, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
score_df <- data.frame(
  Score = sp_seu$BCRS28_Score,
  Group = sp_seu$BCRS28_Group
)

wt <- wilcox.test(Score ~ Group, data=score_df)
plab <- ifelse(wt$p.value < 0.001, "p < 0.001",
               paste0("p = ", round(wt$p.value, 4)))

fig6C <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x=Group, y=Score, fill=Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5, outlier.size=0.5, alpha=0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour=Group), width=0.1, size=0.3, alpha=0.3) +
  annotate("text", x=1.5, y=max(score_df$Score)*1.05,
           label=plab, size=4, fontface="bold") +
  annotate("segment", x=1, xend=2,
           y=max(score_df$Score)*1.02, yend=max(score_df$Score)*1.02) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("BCRS-28 High"="#E41A1C",
                               "BCRS-28 Low"="#2ABAB4")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("BCRS-28 High"="#E41A1C",
                                 "BCRS-28 Low"="#2ABAB4")) +
  labs(title = "C  BCRS-28 Score Distribution",
       x = NULL, y = "BCRS-28 Score") +
  theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold",hjust=0.5),
        legend.position="none")

fig6C
```

### Compose & Save

```{r fig6-save, fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
fig6 <- (fig6A | fig6B | fig6C) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Figure 6 · Spatial Distribution of BCRS-28 in Primary Breast Carcinoma",
    subtitle = paste0("10x Visium | NYU_BRCA0 | n = ",
                      ncol(sp_seu), " spots | ",
                      pct_high, "% BCRS-28 High"),
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust=0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=11, colour="grey40", hjust=0.5)
    )
  )

fig6

ggsave("figures/spatial/Figure6_BCRS28_Spatial.png",
       fig6, width=18, height=7, dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/spatial/Figure6_BCRS28_Spatial.pdf",
       fig6, width=18, height=7)
cat("Figure 6 saved.\n")
```

---

## Step 7 — Individual Gene Spatial Maps (Key BCRS-28 Genes)

```{r gene-maps, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
key_genes <- c("CRIP1", "BAMBI", "GADD45G", "ANGPTL4",
               "TGM2",  "HMOX1", "SCGB3A1", "GBP1")
key_genes <- intersect(key_genes, rownames(sp_seu))

p_genes <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  sp_seu,
  features       = key_genes,
  pt.size.factor = 1.2,
  alpha          = c(0.1, 1),
  ncol           = 4
)

p_genes
ggsave("figures/spatial/FigureS_BCRS28_KeyGenes_Spatial.png",
       p_genes, width=16, height=8, dpi=300)
cat("Key gene spatial maps saved.\n")
```

---

## Step 8 — Spot-Level Statistics Summary

```{r stats-summary}
# Summary statistics
spot_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total spots",
    "BCRS-28 High spots (n)",
    "BCRS-28 High spots (%)",
    "BCRS-28 Low spots (n)",
    "BCRS-28 Low spots (%)",
    "Mean BCRS-28 score (High)",
    "Mean BCRS-28 score (Low)",
    "Up genes found in Visium",
    "Down genes found in Visium"
  ),
  Value = c(
    ncol(sp_seu),
    sum(sp_seu$BCRS28_Group=="BCRS-28 High"),
    paste0(pct_high, "%"),
    sum(sp_seu$BCRS28_Group=="BCRS-28 Low"),
    paste0(100-pct_high, "%"),
    round(mean(score_df$Score[score_df$Group=="BCRS-28 High"]), 3),
    round(mean(score_df$Score[score_df$Group=="BCRS-28 Low"]),  3),
    paste0(length(up_found),   " / ", length(BCRS28_UP)),
    paste0(length(down_found), " / ", length(BCRS28_DOWN))
  )
)

print(spot_summary)
write.csv(spot_summary,
          "supplementary/TableS_Spatial_Summary.csv",
          row.names=FALSE)
cat("✓ Spatial summary saved.\n")
```
